peft.standalone: Adaputala iyi ya LoRA / PEFT imafuna mtundu wake wonse. Lowetsani zoyambira ndikulumikiza adaputala mu Safetensors; Kukula kwa adapter yokha si kukumbukira komwe kumafunikira kuti muyendetse.
peft.description: Sankhani mtundu wathunthu pamwambapa, kenako chikwatu cha adaputala yake. Adaputala yokha si mtundu wathunthu. Chidziwitso choyambira chiyenera kufanana ndi kasinthidwe ka adaputala.
peft.estimate: Conservative CPU kuyerekeza ndi ma tokeni 2,048. Kuwerengetseranso pa chipangizo chomwe mwasankha komanso nkhani panthawi yotsegula. Ma module omwe mukufuna ndi mawonekedwe a tensor amawunikidwa panthawi yotsitsa.

limitedSupport: Wothandizira uyu mwina sangathandizidwe mokwanira. Kuthekera (zida, masomphenya, zomvera) sizidziwikiratu - onjezerani zitsanzo pamanja ndikusintha kuthekera kwa mtundu uliwonse.
mlxExperimental: MLX kuthandizira ndi kuyesa. Zoyikapo sizikupezeka, kusintha kwamalingaliro sikunalumikizidwabe, ndipo zomanga zatsopano zamitundu ina zitha kulephera kutsegula. Nenani zovuta pa GitHub kuti tithe kuziyika patsogolo.
engineBundled: Injini yoyerekeza imapangidwa ndi Novera, kotero palibe chotsitsa kapena kusintha padera. Nenani mawu awa popereka lipoti lachitsanzo chomwe chikulephera kutsegula.
engineOtherVersion: Mukufuna mtundu wina wa llama.cpp? Yendetsani llama-server yanu ndikuwonjezera ngati makonda anu OpenAI-othandizira.
refreshModelsError: Wothandizira akuyenera kukhala ndi zoyambira URL ndi kiyi imodzi yosachepera API yokonzedwa kuti atenge mamodel.
noNewModels: Palibe mitundu yatsopano yomwe yapezeka. Mitundu yonse yomwe ilipo yawonjezeredwa kale.
refreshModelsFailed: Zalephera kutenga zitsanzo kuchokera ku {{provider}}. Chonde onani kiyi yanu ya API ndi poyambira URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa RAG ndi kufufuza kwa vekitala. Mtundu wosankhidwa umakhala wosasinthika popanga zoyika.
importedTooltip: Zachokera ku fayilo yapafupi. Kuchichotsa mu Novera sikuchotsa fayiloyo pa disk.
noModelFoundDesc: Mitundu yomwe ilipo ilembedwa apa. Ngati mulibe mitundu ina iliyonse, pitani ku Hub kuti mutsitse.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Mitundu yomwe ilipo ilembedwa apa. Gwiritsani ntchito batani lotsitsimutsa lomwe lili pamwambapa kuti mutenge zitsanzo kuchokera kwa opereka chithandizo, kapena kuwonjezera pamanja ndi batani la +.

deleteModel.choiceDescription: Sankhani momwe mungachotsere chitsanzochi pa Novera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Chotsani chitsanzocho pamndandanda ndikusunga mafayilo ake pa disk. Mutha kuitanitsanso.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Chotsani mtunduwo ndi mafayilo ake oyendetsedwa ndi Novera pa disk. Izi sizingasinthidwe.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Chotsaninso fayilo yayikulu ya GGUF pomwe idakhazikitsidwa. Mafayilo othandizira akunja amasungidwa. Izi sizingasinthidwe.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Model {{modelId}} idachotsedwa ku Novera. Mafayilo ake adasungidwa.
deleteModel.title: Chotsani Chitsanzo: {{modelId}}
deleteModel.description: Mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuchotsa mtundu uwu? Izi sizingasinthidwe.
deleteModel.importedDescription: Chotsani mtundu womwe watumizidwa ku Novera? Fayilo yanu yapafupi pa litayamba sidzachotsedwa.

deleteAllModels.title: Chotsani mitundu yonse yotsitsidwa?
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: {{count}} mamodel omwe alowetsedwa azisungidwa (mafayilo awo sanatsitsidwe ndi Novera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Yalephera kufufuta {{count}} machitsanzo. Onani console kuti mumve zambiri.

deleteProvider.title: Chotsani Wopereka
deleteProvider.description: Chotsani wopereka uyu ndi mitundu yake yonse. Izi sizingasinthidwe.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuchotsa woperekayu? Izi sizingasinthidwe.

editModel.title: Sinthani Chitsanzo: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Konzani luso lachitsanzo posintha zomwe zili pansipa.

warning.title: Pitirizani Kusamala
warning.description: Kusintha luso lachitsanzo kungakhudze magwiridwe antchito ndi magwiridwe antchito. Zokonda zolakwika zitha kuyambitsa machitidwe kapena zolakwika zosayembekezereka.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Mapeto anu a Azure OpenAI. M'malo YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME ndi dzina lachinthu cha Azure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Gwiritsani ntchito pothera pa Alibaba Cloud workspace yanu ndi dera. M'malo YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID ndi malo anu ogwirira ntchito ID ndikugwiritsa ntchito kiyi ya API yochokera kudera lomwelo.

apiKeys.title: API makiyi
apiKeys.description: Lowetsani kiyi yanu ya API. Mutha kuwonjezera makiyi owonjezera mu Advanced, ndipo Novera idzayesa yotsatirayo yokha kiyiyo ikalephera.
apiKeys.testHint: Imayang'ana /models ndi kiyi iliyonse ndikuwonetsa makiyi aliwonse.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Makiyi osasankha obwerera amasinthidwa mu Advanced.
